limitations: Per-recording note fields and issue selections were empty. The subsequent author statement reports no specific pronunciation issues across the two sets; it is not a detailed word-level or noise/pacing assessment.
Good is an informal categorical judgment, not a MOS value or a phonetic correctness score.
One project-author review is not an independent or native-speaker panel. Language competence is self-reported; native-speaker status was not established.
No listening comparison with the parent English checkpoint was performed.
